svg.title: Buffet menu choices · Menu order, intended intake and tier choice
svg.desc: Reported study architecture. The two studies address different outcomes; perceived value is the reported mediation pathway. Arrows summarize contrasts and the mediation specification; the mediator itself was not randomized.

g.text: Menu order, intended intake and tier choice

path.title: Menu ordering → Intended calories: Condition contrast
Menu ordering → Perceived value: Model path
Perceived value → Higher-tier choice: Indirect pathway
Menu ordering → Higher-tier choice: Tier model

g.title: Participants see menu options and price tiers in different orders. The source describes two stated-preference experiments, with n = 257 and n = 147.
Compare estimated intended intake across menu conditions. This is not weighed food consumption or measured plate waste.
The reported indirect-effect analysis examines perceived value. Interpretation depends on mediation assumptions as well as randomized presentation.
The reported odds ratio is 0.52. Odds, choice probability and premium share are different quantities; the study reports them separately.
